validation.meaning: Real engine orders and registered ability combinations; the three incoming disable cases use controlled status preconditions. Replay cases use unmodified initial-player scenarios. Only named assertions certify behavior.

implementationNotes: Status removal hooks cover engine dispel/natural-expiry paths once per instance, preserving released damage/points/attribution; they do not intercept arbitrary manual array consumption.
